observed_scope: Built production HTML inspection after initial publication dispatch
issue: Existing display sanitizer suppresses semicolon-delimited clauses containing preservation/archive terminology. The original single paragraph contained that vocabulary and the capture field was omitted.
change: Only the new record’s capture description is rewritten as visitor-facing capture and limitation prose. No source, model, image, pose, appearance, rights, size or exhibition change.
capture_label: 75-image photogrammetry by Frédérique Bertrand / 3D Imago Urbis, processed in 3DF Zephyr. The scanner identifies this bronze example at Musée Bourdelle in Paris. The capture includes the hollow rear and mounting support. Dark interior surfaces and small facets on the cap and collar have limited recorded detail. The exact cast date, foundry and physical size are unconfirmed. Atrium reduced the geometry for web delivery while retaining the photographed green-brown patina and original unlit material.
